title: SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 Online Form (15,000 Posts)
headline: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) Combined Graduate Level CGL 2026 Online Form
tags: SSC CGL, SSC, Graduate, Govt Job, Study Topper
short_desc: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has invited online applications for the recruitment of Combined Graduate Level CGL 2026 for approximately 15,000 Group B & C Vacancies across various Ministries and Departments of Govt of India.
html_content:
SSC Combined Graduate Level CGL Examination 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 19/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 30/09/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date : 01/10/2026
  • Correction Window : 03-04 October 2026
  • Tier 1 Exam Date : November / December 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 100/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 0/- (Exempted)
  • All Category Female : Rs. 0/- (Nil)
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or UPI.

SSC CGL 2026 Age Limit Criteria (as on 01/08/2026)

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 27 - 32 Years (Post Wise)
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per SSC CGL 2026 Recruitment Rules (OBC: 3 Yrs, SC/ST: 5 Yrs).

Vacancy & Eligibility Details (Total : 15,000 Posts)

Post Name Total Posts Eligibility Criteria
Assistant Section Officer (ASO), Inspector (GST / Examiner / PO), Sub Inspector (CBI), Tax Assistant, Auditor, Accountant 15,000 Posts Bachelor's Degree in Any Stream from Any Recognized University in India. For detailed post-wise criteria read full notification.

How to Fill SSC CGL 2026 Online Application Form

  1. Candidate can apply online between 19 August 2026 to 30 September 2026.
  2. Candidate must read official notification carefully before applying the recruitment form.
  3. Kindly check and collect all required documents: Eligibility proof, ID proof, Address details, Basic details.
  4. Keep ready scan document related to recruitment form: Photo, Sign, ID Proof, etc.
  5. Before submit the application form must check preview and all columns carefully.
  6. If candidate is required to pay application fee must submit. Take a print out of final submitted form.
